name: @starter-saas/gateway
description: Fastify-based HTTP gateway for StarterSaaS per D-24 + D-25. Ships a `createGateway()` factory with Zod boundary discipline (every route validates inputs/outputs), structured 400 errors, and an opinionated tenant-context plugin that pre-wires the per-tenant rate-limit + RBAC middleware from `@starter-saas/tenancy`. STORY-016 of EPIC-004.
